FIXED (AZ-15, commit 40512080a77b76dde86aca924a3eb8f030632dc0). Root cause: AssistantPanel's `.assistant--floating` was position:fixed at a constant viewport coordinate (AssistantPanel.css:8-9 pre-fix), so it permanently painted over whatever body text scrolled underneath -- erasing the word 'public' mid-sentence on /contact and the 'What the app does' heading on /about, confirmed by opening the pre-fix screenshots and by a bounding-rect intersection measurement against every leaf text node. Fix: the trigger now renders in normal document flow directly under the breadcrumbs (Layout.tsx, Layout.css .layout__assistant-dock) and only the opened panel is an anchored absolute-position dropdown (AssistantPanel.css), never a full-viewport-fixed element.
